- cc-log: Lightweight system log to record all Claude Code behavior (tool use, subagent creation, compaction, permissions, session lifecycle) for analysis. Use when the user wants to enable/disable behavior logging, analyze Claude Code session logs, list saved logs, or understand Claude Code's tool usage patterns. Trigger on: "cc-log", "behavior log", "system log", "record behavior", "log enable", "log disable", "analyze log".
- iree-optimizer: Agentic per-dispatch tile-size tuner for IREE CPU codegen on RISC-V. Keeps IREE's chosen pipeline (CPUDoubleTilingExpert / CPUConvTileAndDecomposeExpert / CPUBufferOpsTileAndVectorize) and only overrides the root linalg op's lowering_config<tile_sizes = [...]>. Each round reads the best-so-far RISC-V assembly (LMUL, VLmax, register spills) to ground the next tile-size proposal; pre-compile divisibility gate ensures tiles divide their parent extents (no tail loop); a post-compile check of the IR after iree-codegen-generic-vectorization confirms no tail/masked main path. Compiles via iree_tuner.py, benchmarks on FPGA, iterates. Use whenever the user mentions tuning IREE dispatch tile sizes, agentic tile search, or wants to replace GA-based tile-size search with LLM-driven search. Trigger on "iree optimize", "optimize dispatch", "tile tune", or references to dispatch .mlir files for performance tuning.
- libnn-optimizer: Autonomous optimization workflow for libnn RISC-V neural network library functions
in the agentic_libnn_opt project. Use this skill when the user wants to optimize a
libnn function for FPGA performance, run the libnn optimization loop, validate the
optimization config, parse FPGA hardware features, extract shapes from perf test files,
or manage the optimization state machine. Trigger when: user mentions "optimize",
"libnn", "FPGA perf", "optimization loop", "validate config",
"phase gather/baseline/iterate/evaluate", "perf test", or references opt/config.toml,
opt/state.json, or any libnn function optimization task.

Use this skill whenever someone asks to generate, write, or modify a transform dialect script, transform library, codegen strategy, or tuning spec in MLIR. Also trigger when the request involves composing IR transformations for linalg ops, controlling IREE codegen pipelines via transform dialect, or replacing annotation-only configs with full transform strategies. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, edit, or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy.

Run before committing nontrivial changes. Don't invoke it on a diff that only touches tests, docs, or other code with no runtime surface to drive (a change to product source always has one) — there's nothing to observe.

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# U2 contract (ROADMAP_LINUX_RUNTIME.md): `andesim run --mode fast --runtime
3	# linux app.elf -- <app argv>` stages a manifested vlinux.elf (this run's app
4	# path + mem-size stamped into its .manifest section via objcopy) and boots
5	# THAT under -bios, instead of the app ELF directly.
6	#
7	# Scope for U2: only --mode fast is wired (cycle/hybrid are rejected for now;
8	# hybrid wiring is ROADMAP_LINUX_RUNTIME.md U9). App argv (-- ...) threads
9	# into the manifest as argv[1..] (U8) -- this dry-run test proves the
10	# objcopy step + manifest app-path AND argv round-trip, matching the
11	# roadmap's Input/Output contract.
12	set -uo pipefail
13	
14	SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
15	ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
16	. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"
17	
18	TC="${HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN:-$(cfg_val HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN)}"
19	[ -n "$TC" ] || fail "HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN not set (env or config.env)"
20	export HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN="$TC"
21	
22	bash "$ROOT/scripts/build_driver.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "build_driver.sh failed"
23	BIN="$ROOT/build/andesim"
24	[ -x "$BIN" ] || fail "missing andesim binary: $BIN"
25	
26	make -C "$ROOT/runtime/linux" >/dev/null || fail "vlinux build failed"
27	[ -f "$ROOT/build/runtime/linux/vlinux.elf" ] || fail "missing vlinux.elf"
28	
29	elf=$(ls "$ROOT"/tests/fixtures/handoff_roundtrip.elf 2>/dev/null \
30	      || ls "$ROOT"/tests/fixtures/*.elf 2>/dev/null | head -1)
31	[ -n "$elf" ] || fail "no fixture ELF under tests/fixtures"
32	
33	# 1. dry-run contract: objcopy step printed, -bios <workdir>/vlinux-run.elf,
34	#    engine-synced CPU, the 1G mem-size default, qemu itself stays a preview.
35	out=$(timeout 30 "$BIN" run --mode fast --runtime linux --dry-run "$elf" \
36	      -- -m x.gguf -t 1 2>&1); rc=$?
37	[ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || fail "dry-run exit $rc: $out"
38	printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q 'riscv64-unknown-elf-objcopy' \
39	  || fail "missing the objcopy step: $out"
40	printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q -- '--update-section .manifest=' \
41	  || fail "missing --update-section .manifest=: $out"
42	printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q 'dry-run: 1 command' \
43	  || fail "qemu itself should stay a preview (1 command), not run: $out"
44	printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -qE -- '-bios [^ ]*/vlinux-run\.elf' \
45	  || fail "missing -bios <workdir>/vlinux-run.elf: $out"
46	printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q -- '-m 1024M' \
47	  || fail "--runtime linux should default --mem-size to 1G: $out"
48	printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q -- '-cpu andes-ax45mpv,vlen=512' \
49	  || fail "missing the engine-synced CPU override: $out"
50	printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -qi 'not wired yet' \
51	  && fail "app argv (-- ...) should thread through now (U8), not warn-and-drop: $out"
52	ok "fast --runtime linux --dry-run: objcopy step + -bios <workdir>/vlinux-run.elf"
53	
54	# 2. manifest content round-trips: readelf -p on the staged ELF's .manifest
55	#    section shows this run's app path AND its extra argv (U8) -- the
56	#    staged file is not cleaned up.
57	vlinux_run=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -oE '[^ ]*/vlinux-run\.elf' | head -1)
58	[ -n "$vlinux_run" ] && [ -f "$vlinux_run" ] \
59	  || fail "staged vlinux-run.elf not found on disk: $vlinux_run"
60	READELF="$TC/bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-readelf"
61	[ -x "$READELF" ] || fail "missing toolchain readelf: $READELF"
62	manifest_dump=$("$READELF" -p .manifest "$vlinux_run" 2>/dev/null)
63	printf '%s' "$manifest_dump" | grep -qF "$elf" \
64	  || fail "manifest .manifest section does not contain the app path $elf"
65	printf '%s' "$manifest_dump" | grep -qF 'x.gguf' \
66	  || fail "manifest .manifest section does not contain the app's extra argv (-m x.gguf): $manifest_dump"
67	ok "manifest blob round-trips: readelf -p .manifest shows the app path AND argv"
68	
69	# 3. --mem-size still overrides the 1G default.
70	out=$(timeout 30 "$BIN" run --mode fast --runtime linux --mem-size 256M \
71	      --dry-run "$elf" 2>&1); rc=$?
72	[ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || fail "--mem-size 256M dry-run exit $rc: $out"
73	printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q -- '-m 256M' \
74	  || fail "--mem-size should override the 1G default: $out"
75	ok "--mem-size overrides the --runtime linux default"
76	
77	# 4. negative: unknown --runtime value.
78	out=$(timeout 10 "$BIN" run --mode fast --runtime bogus "$elf" --dry-run 2>&1); rc=$?
79	[ "$rc" -eq 2 ] || fail "--runtime bogus should exit 2, got $rc: $out"
80	printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -qi "unknown --runtime" \
81	  || fail "missing the unknown --runtime diagnostic: $out"
82	ok "--runtime bogus rejected"
83	
84	# 5. negative: --runtime linux requires --mode fast or hybrid (cycle: no
85	#    roadmap need, never wired).
86	out=$(timeout 10 "$BIN" run --mode cycle --runtime linux "$elf" --dry-run 2>&1); rc=$?
87	[ "$rc" -eq 2 ] || fail "--runtime linux --mode cycle should exit 2, got $rc: $out"
88	ok "--runtime linux --mode cycle rejected (never wired, no roadmap need)"
89	
90	# 6. --mode hybrid --runtime linux (U9): both legs boot the SAME staged
91	#    vlinux-run.elf; -- args (app argv) thread through despite hybrid's
92	#    general "no -- args" rule (they are app argv, not engine flags).
93	out=$(timeout 30 "$BIN" run --mode hybrid --trigger marker \
94	      --engine vsim:ax45mpv_premium --runtime linux --dry-run "$elf" \
95	      -- -m x.gguf -t 1 2>&1); rc=$?
96	[ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || fail "hybrid --runtime linux --dry-run exit $rc: $out"
97	printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q 'riscv64-unknown-elf-objcopy' \
98	  || fail "hybrid: missing the objcopy staging step: $out"
99	printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q '2 command(s)' \
100	  || fail "hybrid: expected 2 commands (fast-leg + accurate-leg): $out"
101	printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -qE -- '-bios [^ ]*/vlinux-run\.elf' \
102	  || fail "hybrid: fast-leg missing -bios <workdir>/vlinux-run.elf: $out"
103	printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -qE '^/[^ ]*/sim_ax45mpv_premium [^ ]*/vlinux-run\.elf' \
104	  || fail "hybrid: accurate-leg missing vlinux-run.elf as its positional ELF: $out"
105	# vsim's OWN trigger only static-pre-scans whatever ELF it is handed (here,
106	# vlinux-run.elf -- which has no markers, they're in $elf); the driver
107	# resolves $elf's real exit-marker PC (handoff_roundtrip.S: 0x10000c, known
108	# from objdump) and feeds vsim PC-mode instead. QEMU1 keeps plain marker
109	# mode (its dynamic, content-agnostic detection already works either way).
110	printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q -- '--hybrid-exit-pc 0x10000c' \
111	  || fail "hybrid: accurate-leg missing --hybrid-exit-pc 0x10000c (the app's real exit marker): $out"
112	ok "hybrid --runtime linux --dry-run: both legs boot the same staged vlinux-run.elf, argv threads through, vsim gets the app's real exit-marker PC"
113

LINUX_TOOLCHAIN + a pre-built llama-completion + the GGUF model, none

## U9. Hybrid: one-kernel-iteration ROI

- Description: the actual goal. Two supported ways to delimit ONE
  iteration: (a) marker build - a 5-line llama.cpp patch snippet
  (documented, kept in docs/) adds `<andesim/ROI.h>` markers around the
  target op guarded by an iteration counter (`if (++n == K)`), markers
  are HINT NOPs so the same binary still runs everywhere; (b) no-source
  route - `andesim profile` finds the hot loop, then `--trigger pc
  --pc-start/--pc-end` with symbols resolved from the app ELF (U2).
  Results print INSIDE the ROI (nothing after ROI-end executes - the
  existing contract). Expectation note for the guide: one Bonsai-4B-shape
  (2560 embed) q1_0 matvec is smaller than the original 27B estimate
  (~10-100 M cycles there) -> likely faster than minutes-to-~1h at
  vsim's 9-50 kHz, confirm actual figure once measured; a full token
  would still be far too slow - that is why we measure one iteration.
- Input/Output: hybrid run of a marker'd glibc matvec fixture (and then
  llama-completion with the counter patch) prints in-ROI checksum +
  `[andesim] N cycles`, N stable across two runs (deterministic single hart).
- Key files: docs/USER_GUIDE.md, docs/llama_roi_howto.md (new, with the
  counter-marker snippet), tests/vlinux/test_vlinux_hybrid_roi.sh

  measures ONE real transformer matmul. Verified deterministic across two

  across two runs. This alone proves hybrid+`--runtime linux`+marker-ROI
